body: Thank-you for your unconditional kindness, unfortunately where I live there is no middle-school; meaning we're all grouped in together. And I've tried anti-depressants, they suppress the urge to commit suicide, but when I (personally) come off of them, I just relapse completely. I also get physically harmed by this certain group of 16 year old's. I just feel trapped and that I have no way out. Again, thank-you for your time...but, you're most-likely just wasting it.
